question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "access." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"access"** means to find information on a computer. (कंप्‍यूटर में विशिष्‍ट जानकारी तक पहुँचना)
 
• The reason for using** "access"** in the blank is to convey the action of retrieving or obtaining scientific data from numerous satellites.
 
• In the context of satellite communication and data retrieval, the term **"access"** implies the capability of scientists to connect with or retrieve information from satellites.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is** Option 1.**
 
• **Correct paragraph:**

**​...........**The beaming frequencies of satellites that are 'parked' too close to one another must not interfere with one another. Television signals can be transmitted from one location to other using broadcast satellites, and scientists can **access**__ scientific data from numerous satellites.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Entry: **the act of coming or going into a place. (किसी स्‍थान में जाने या प्रवेश करने की क्रिया; प्रवेश)
 
• **Approach: **to come near or nearer to somebody/something. (पास आना या पहुँचना)
 
• **Ingress: **the action or fact of going in or entering; the capacity or right of entrance. (अंदर जाने या प्रवेश करने की क्रिया या तथ्य; प्रवेश की क्षमता या अधिकार)
